name: How much does a second story addition cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a second story addition cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a second story addition in Los Angeles varies significantly based on factors like the size of the addition, complexity of the design, materials chosen, and existing structural conditions. On average, you can expect costs to range from $100,000 to over $300,000. This estimate typically includes architectural plans, permits, labor, and materials. A detailed on-site consultation is essential for an accurate, personalized quote tailored to your specific project and property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a second story addition in Los Angeles generally range from $100,000 to over $300,000, depending on size, complexity, and materials.
